lines.en: Good morning, and welcome to Harbor Trading. I'm Linda from human resources.
lines.zh: 早安，歡迎加入 Harbor Trading。我是人資部的 Linda。

lines.en: This morning, you'll get your badges and fill out your payroll forms.
lines.zh: 今天上午，各位會拿到識別證，並填寫薪資表格。

lines.en: After lunch, our technician, Mr. Wu, will help you set up your computers.
lines.zh: 午餐後，我們的技術人員吳先生會協助各位設定電腦。

lines.en: Please note that the cafeteria is closed today, so lunch will be served in the meeting room on the second floor.
lines.zh: 請注意，員工餐廳今天沒開，所以午餐會在二樓的會議室供應。

lines.en: Tomorrow at nine, each of you will meet your supervisor.
lines.zh: 明天九點，各位會和自己的主管見面。

questions.en: Who is the speaker most likely talking to?
questions.zh: 說話者最有可能是在對誰說話？

questions.en: Why will lunch be in a meeting room today?
questions.zh: 今天的午餐為什麼在會議室？
options: A client is visiting the second floor.
The meeting will go through lunch.
The computers are set up there.
The place they normally eat is closed.

questions.en: What is planned for nine o'clock tomorrow?
questions.zh: 明天九點安排了什麼？

lines.en: Hi. Our flight to Osaka was canceled. Can you put us on another one today?
lines.zh: 你好，我們飛大阪的班機取消了。可以幫我們改搭今天的其他班次嗎？

lines.en: Let me check. The afternoon flight at one fifteen is full, I'm afraid. But there are two seats on the last one of the day.
lines.zh: 我查一下。下午一點十五分那班恐怕已經客滿了，不過今天最後一班還有兩個位子。

lines.en: That's fine. We have a meeting early tomorrow morning, so we just need to get there tonight.
lines.zh: 那樣可以。我們明天一早有會議，只要今晚能到就好。

lines.en: All right. Here are your new boarding passes. You can wait in the lounge near gate eight.
lines.zh: 好的，這是兩位新的登機證。可以在八號登機門附近的貴賓室等候。

lines.en: Thanks. Can we check our suitcases with you now?
lines.zh: 謝謝。我們現在可以在你這裡托運行李箱嗎？

lines.en: Yes. Please put them up here, one at a time.
lines.zh: 可以，請一次一件放上來。

questions.en: Look at the table. Which flight will the man take?
questions.zh: 請看表格。男子會搭哪一班飛機？

questions.en: Why does the man need to arrive in Osaka tonight?
questions.zh: 男子為什麼今晚就要到大阪？
options: He wants to rest in the lounge.
He has a meeting early the next day.

questions.en: What will the man most likely do next?
questions.zh: 男子接下來最有可能做什麼？

lines.en: Good evening, everyone, and thank you for coming to our tenth anniversary party.
lines.zh: 大家晚安，謝謝各位來參加我們的十週年慶祝派對。

lines.en: Ten years ago, we had only five workers in one small office. Tonight, there are more than eighty of us in this hall.
lines.zh: 十年前，我們只有五個員工，擠在一間小辦公室。今晚，這個大廳裡有超過八十位同仁。

lines.en: Before dinner is served, I'd like to give an award to someone special.
lines.zh: 在晚餐上菜之前，我想頒一個獎給一位特別的人。

lines.en: This year, Emma Lin from customer service helped us win three large new clients. Please come up to the stage, Emma.
lines.zh: 今年，客服部的林艾瑪幫我們拿下了三個大客戶。請上台吧，艾瑪。

questions.en: What is being celebrated?
questions.zh: 這是在慶祝什麼？
options: A company's ten years in business
The opening of a larger office
The arrival of three new workers
A new partner from another country

questions.en: What is suggested about Emma Lin?
questions.zh: 關於林艾瑪，談話中暗示了什麼？
options: She started the company ten years ago.
She brought in a lot of new business.
She will give a speech after dinner.

lines.en: I have to move tomorrow's team meeting. A client is coming to see me at ten.
lines.zh: 我得把明天的團隊會議改時間。十點有客戶要來找我。

lines.en: No problem, Ms. Chen. Would the afternoon work? The conference room is free after two.
lines.zh: 沒問題，陳經理。下午可以嗎？會議室兩點以後是空的。

lines.en: Two is fine. Could you tell the team and change the time on the calendar?
lines.zh: 兩點可以。你可以通知大家，並把行事曆上的時間改掉嗎？

lines.en: Sure. Should I print the sales report for everyone, too?
lines.zh: 好。我也要幫大家印銷售報告嗎？

lines.en: No, just send it to them by email. That will save paper.
lines.zh: 不用，直接用電子郵件寄給大家就好，可以省紙。

questions.en: Why does the team meeting need to change?
questions.zh: 團隊會議為什麼要改時間？
options: The sales report is not ready.
The man will be out of the office.

questions.en: How will the sales report be shared?
questions.zh: 銷售報告會用什麼方式分享？
options: It will be printed for everyone.
Everyone will get it by email.
It will be shown on a screen at two.
It will be put on the calendar.

lines.en: Hello, this is David Brown from Northway Retail.
lines.zh: 您好，我是 Northway Retail 的 David Brown。

lines.en: I visited your booth at the trade fair last week, and I really liked your new bags.
lines.zh: 我上星期在商展參觀過你們的攤位，很喜歡你們的新款包包。

lines.en: I'd like to order three hundred, but first I need to see a sample of the black one.
lines.zh: 我想訂三百個，但我得先看一下黑色那款的樣品。

lines.en: Could you send one to my office by Friday? Our team will decide next Monday.
lines.zh: 可以在星期五前寄一個到我辦公室嗎？我們團隊下星期一會做決定。

lines.en: My email address is on the business card I gave you. Thanks.
lines.zh: 我的電子郵件地址在我給您的名片上。謝謝。

questions.en: Where did the speaker learn about the bags?
questions.zh: 說話者是在哪裡知道這些包包的？

questions.en: What must happen before the speaker places an order?
questions.zh: 說話者下訂單之前，必須先發生什麼事？
options: He must look at a sample.
He must visit the booth again.
His team must meet on Friday.
He must get a new business card.

lines.en: Hi, I'm looking at the price list you sent. We need about two hundred and fifty boxes of gloves.
lines.zh: 你好，我正在看你寄來的價目表。我們需要大約兩百五十箱手套。

lines.en: Sure. But if you order fifty more, you'll get our lowest price.
lines.zh: 沒問題。不過如果您再多訂五十箱，就能拿到我們最低的價格。

lines.en: Well, we don't have enough storage space for that many.
lines.zh: 嗯，我們沒有足夠的空間放那麼多。

lines.en: I understand. Then I can deliver them in two parts, one this month and one next month.
lines.zh: 我了解。那我可以分兩次送，這個月一次，下個月一次。

lines.en: That would work. Let me get approval from my director first.
lines.zh: 那樣可以。我先請我們總經理核准。

questions.en: Look at the table. What price per box does the man say the woman could get?
questions.zh: 請看表格。男子說女子可以拿到每箱多少錢的價格？

questions.en: Why is the woman worried about a larger order?
questions.zh: 女子為什麼擔心訂更多？
options: Her company has no room to keep it.
The price per box is too high.
The delivery would take two months.
Her director is away this month.

questions.en: What does the man offer to do?
questions.zh: 男子提議做什麼？
options: Lower the price of every box

lines.en: Good morning, everyone. Before we start, I have three quick notes.
lines.zh: 大家早安。開始之前，我有三件事要很快說一下。

lines.en: First, a large shipment from the port will arrive at ten, so I need four people at dock two.
lines.zh: 第一，有一批從港口來的大貨十點會到，所以我需要四個人到二號碼頭。

lines.en: Second, the electrical team is checking the alarm system today. If you hear the alarm before noon, you don't need to leave the building.
lines.zh: 第二，電工團隊今天在檢查警報系統。中午前如果聽到警報，不用離開大樓。

lines.en: Finally, please wear your gloves when you lift heavy boxes. Last week, two workers hurt their hands.
lines.zh: 最後，搬重的箱子時請戴手套。上星期有兩位同仁手受傷了。

lines.en: Thanks, and have a safe day.
lines.zh: 謝謝，祝大家今天平安。

questions.en: Where does the speaker most likely work?
questions.zh: 說話者最有可能在哪裡工作？

questions.en: How many people are needed at dock two?
questions.zh: 二號碼頭需要幾個人？

questions.en: Why does the speaker mention what happened last week?
questions.zh: 說話者為什麼提到上星期發生的事？
options: To show why gloves are important
To explain why a shipment is late
To thank two workers for their help
To describe a problem with the alarm

lines.en: Hi, I'm checking out. Could I keep my bags here until three? My flight isn't until six.
lines.zh: 你好，我要退房。我的行李可以放在這裡到三點嗎？我的班機六點才飛。

lines.en: Sure, I'll put them in our storage room. Do you need a taxi to the airport?
lines.zh: 當然，我會放到我們的行李間。您需要叫計程車去機場嗎？

lines.en: Yes, please. Can you book one for three thirty?
lines.zh: 好，麻煩你。可以幫我叫三點半的車嗎？

lines.en: No problem. But there's also a free shuttle bus at three, if you'd like.
lines.zh: 沒問題。不過三點也有免費的接駁車，如果您想搭的話。

lines.en: The bus sounds good. I'll take that instead.
lines.zh: 接駁車不錯，那我改搭那個。

questions.en: Why does the man want to leave his bags at the hotel?
questions.zh: 男子為什麼想把行李留在飯店？
options: His room is not ready yet.
His flight leaves later in the day.
He has a meeting at three thirty.

questions.en: How will the man most likely get to the airport?
questions.zh: 男子最有可能怎麼去機場？

lines.en: Hi, this is Ms. Carter. I just read the report you sent this morning.
lines.zh: 嗨，我是 Carter。我剛看完你今天早上寄來的報告。

lines.en: It's very clear, but the sales figures for March look wrong. They're exactly the same as February's.
lines.zh: 報告寫得很清楚，可是三月的銷售數字看起來不對，跟二月的一模一樣。

lines.en: Could you check them and send me a revised version before the meeting on Thursday?
lines.zh: 你可以檢查一下，在星期四開會前寄修改過的版本給我嗎？

lines.en: Also, please add a slide about our new customers in Taichung. Call me if you have any questions.
lines.zh: 另外，請加一張關於我們台中新客戶的投影片。有任何問題就打給我。

questions.en: What problem does the speaker mention?
questions.zh: 說話者提到什麼問題？
options: Some numbers seem to be copied from another month.
The report was sent too late.
The meeting was moved to Thursday.
The report is hard to understand.

questions.en: What does the speaker want added to the report?
questions.zh: 說話者希望報告裡加上什麼？

lines.en: Welcome to our booth. Can I help you find something?
lines.zh: 歡迎來到我們的攤位。需要幫您找什麼嗎？

lines.en: Yes. I have three gift shops in London, and I need small, light bags for tourists.
lines.zh: 是的。我在倫敦有三家禮品店，我需要給觀光客用的小而輕的包包。

lines.en: Then you'll like this new model. It's small enough to go in a pocket, and it comes in six colors.
lines.zh: 那您會喜歡這個新款。它小到可以放進口袋，而且有六種顏色。

lines.en: Nice. Do you have a catalog I can take with me? I need to show my partner.
lines.zh: 不錯。有目錄可以讓我帶走嗎？我要給我的合夥人看。

lines.en: Here you go. And all orders made during the fair get ten percent off.
lines.zh: 這給您。另外，在展期間下的訂單都打九折。

questions.en: Who most likely is the man?
questions.zh: 男子最有可能是什麼人？

questions.en: What does the woman say about orders placed during the fair?
questions.zh: 關於在展期間下的訂單，女子說了什麼？
options: They come with a free catalog.
They must be for ten bags or more.
